what: A row showing two cards loops endlessly, sliding left one step (card width + gap) every 5s on a spring (stiffness 200 · damping 40 · mass 1, settling in about .9s with no overshoot). A card leaving the left edge of the panel pivots on its right edge, and a card entering from the right pivots on its left edge, changing straight by slot position between .9x · opacity 0 ↔ 1x · 1. The prev and next buttons advance one step (pressed state .9x · .15s) and restart the 5s count. It does not pause on hover, and it rests when off-screen

options.[data-fx-part=track]: Row holding the cards (each child is one card) — the part duplicates three sets and appends them after
options.[data-fx-part=prev] · [data-fx-part=next: Prev and next buttons (optional) — their position is set by the css that uses them
options.auto: If off, does not advance automatically
options.scale · opacity: Scale and opacity one step outside the panel, default .9·0
options.fx:slide: Event fired from the element on swipe (detail.index — original card order)
options.items-narrow · narrow: Number of cards on narrow screens (default 809.98px or below), same as default items — original phone version is 1

use:
• Card 1
  • Card 2
  • Card 3
note: The original uses Framer Motion’s animate (spring) — we imitated it by integrating the same spring equation in 1ms steps. The row wraps by one set length like Framer, moving only within (−two sets, −one set], and no overflow is set on the view so cards outside it stay visible
